questions.e: In the video: "idemo kod moje američke porodice" — we are going to my American family.

questions.q: How many hours does it take to get to Boston?
questions.e: In the video: "do kog nam treba oko četiri sata" — which takes about four hours.

questions.q: What big mistake did she make?
questions.e: In the video: "presvukla sam se u pidžamu" — I changed into pyjamas.

questions.q: What did she do with her suitcases at one a.m.?
questions.e: In the video: "sam stavila kofere sa mojim vrednim stvarima u shopping kolica" — I put the suitcases with my valuable things in shopping carts.
